title: Verify positive main flow for Enable Customers to Reset Their Password
preconditions: Customer has a registered account with a valid email address
Customer is on the login page
Password policy is defined in the system

testSteps.action: Customer clicks the "Forgot password" link on the login page.
testSteps.expectedResult: System displays the password reset request form.

testSteps.action: Customer enters their registered email address and submits the form.
testSteps.expectedResult: System validates email format and existence, generates a one‑time reset token (expires in 30 minutes), stores it, and sends a reset link to the email.

testSteps.action: Customer receives the email and clicks the reset link.
testSteps.expectedResult: System verifies the token is valid and unexpired, then presents the new password entry screen.

testSteps.action: Customer enters a new password that complies with the password policy and confirms it.
testSteps.expectedResult: System validates the password and confirmation, updates the customer's password, invalidates the token, signs out all active sessions, and shows a success confirmation message.

expectedResults: System validates the password and confirmation, updates the customer's password, invalidates the token, signs out all active sessions, and shows a success confirmation message.

title: Verify exception handling: Invalid or Non‑existent Email
preconditions: Customer has a registered account with a valid email address
Customer is on the login page
Password policy is defined in the system

testSteps.action: Set up scenario where Submitted email does not match any registered account.

testSteps.expectedResult: System displays a generic error message: "If the email is registered, a reset link will be sent," without revealing account existence.

expectedResults: System displays a generic error message: "If the email is registered, a reset link will be sent," without revealing account existence.

title: Verify exception handling: Expired/Used/Invalid Reset Token
preconditions: Customer has a registered account with a valid email address
Customer is on the login page
Password policy is defined in the system

testSteps.action: Set up scenario where Customer clicks a reset link that is expired, already used, or malformed.

testSteps.expectedResult: System shows an error message: "The reset link is invalid or has expired." and provides a button to request a new reset link.

expectedResults: System shows an error message: "The reset link is invalid or has expired." and provides a button to request a new reset link.

title: Verify exception handling: Password Policy Violation
preconditions: Customer has a registered account with a valid email address
Customer is on the login page
Password policy is defined in the system

testSteps.action: Set up scenario where New password does not meet the defined password policy.

testSteps.expectedResult: System highlights the policy requirements and prevents submission until the password complies.

expectedResults: System highlights the policy requirements and prevents submission until the password complies.

expectedResults: Alternate pathway Resend Reset Link completes successfully

title: Verify data validation rules for Enable Customers to Reset Their Password
preconditions: Customer has a registered account with a valid email address
Customer is on the login page
Password policy is defined in the system

testSteps.action: Attempt input violating rules for: email (Must be a valid email format; must exist in Customer table.), resetToken (Stored hashed; expires after 30 minutes; single‑use.), newPassword (Minimum 12 characters, at least one uppercase, one lowercase, one digit, one special character; must not match last 5 passwords.), tokenCreationTimestamp (Used to calculate expiration.)

Provide compliant inputs for: email (Must be a valid email format; must exist in Customer table.), resetToken (Stored hashed; expires after 30 minutes; single‑use.), newPassword (Minimum 12 characters, at least one uppercase, one lowercase, one digit, one special character; must not match last 5 passwords.), tokenCreationTimestamp (Used to calculate expiration.)

expectedResults: System enforces input data requirements correctly
